title: crew.config.json
description: Everything crew needs to know about one project. Prose belongs in projectBrief, not here.

project.description: Human name, used on the board and in the graph.

graphProject.description: Project node name in the memory graph. Defaults to project.

projectBrief.description: Markdown the worker and reviewer roles include. All project-specific prose lives here.

decisionsFile.description: Where /crew-close records a decision in prose, alongside the graph.

backlogFile.description: Read by /crew-status to say what to pick up next.

verify.description: The command that proves a task. The gate runs it and will not stamp without it.

prepare.description: Commands the gate runs before verify, per worktree — a fixture, a seed, an install.

reviewRounds.description: Rounds before a human decides. A round past this is two agents disagreeing.

models.description: default for well-specified work; critical for the code that must not be wrong.

fromDir.description: Source roots. Every directory and module name under them, at any depth, is a valid commit scope.

extra.description: Scopes with no directory of their own: docs, ci, deps.

banned.description: Substrings rejected anywhere in the message, matched case-insensitively.

extensions.description: File extensions whose comment lines are counted. Markdown is deliberately absent.

preCommit.description: Fast staged-file checks for the pre-commit hook. Milliseconds only.

fix.description: Command to suggest when it fails.

environments.description: Where a task can be proved. Any environment with reachableFromAgents: false gets its own pending-<name> status, which is how code-complete work is stopped from calling itself done.

log.description: JSONL of task events, so the cost of the loop can be checked.
